Harbor desk copy from Kralendijk. Rafael Martis took the noon boat stamp and filed the page while it was still damp. The masthead sender is Anchorline Chandlery on slip KC-7721. The printed charge is [[fee]]USD 1,486.75[[/]] for chain, two fenders, and a short splice. The stamp date reads [[issued]]17 March 2026[[/]]. A pencilled "masha danki" sits under the box, and the scan broke chan-
dlery across the crease. Older slip KC-7714 quoting 890.00 is in the same folder and is the wrong sheet. No insurer block was filled. A coffee ring hides the phone line, the stamp says PART PAID, and the clerk initialled RM.

Shop copy kept in Willemstad. Liselotte Wijngaarde slid it over the counter with a thumb smudge on the corner. Folio Press bill WM-3088 lists [[line]]harbour chart folio[[/]], [[line]]pilot lamp set[[/]], and [[line]]waxed envelope pack[[/]]. Printed job charge [[fee]]638.40[[/]]. Issued [[issued]]4 June 2026[[/]], credit line [[netdays]]21[[/]] days. Under the stamp she wrote "paga den tempu". Quote WM-3081 for 512.00 was crossed out and is not this sheet. The margin OCR split fol-
io on the carbon. A red PAID stamp overlaps the till line, and the clerk dotted the corner twice.

marked_text:
Provision slip written at The Bottom, on Saba. Elsje Hassell filled it while the generator coughed through the morning landing. Stone Steps Provisions bill SB-1146 shows printed charge [[fee]]USD 2,075.40[[/]] for rice, lamp oil, and nails. Heading date [[opened]]9 February 2027[[/]], credit strip [[hold]]18[[/]] days. She added "betaald half" in the margin, and the scanner split provi-
sions on a crease. Prior note SB-1102 quoting 1,990.00 is clipped behind this page and is the wrong total. No policy code was typed on the form. The RECEIVED stamp is blurred and the pencil note trails off.

ask.instruction: Start date plus the credit days

ask.instruction: Policy code typed on the form

Workshop ticket left in Cockburn Town. Idris Forbes set it on the bench after the rain squall. Osprey Forge bill CT-5519 covers [[job]]hinge pin replacement[[/]], [[job]]deck cleat weld[[/]], and [[job]]locker latch reset[[/]]. Labour is [[hours]]6[[/]] hours at [[rate]]87.25[[/]] per hour. Clock-out reads [[closed]]3:40 pm[[/]]. Ticket date [[issued]]11/08/2026[[/]]. He scrawled "work dun" below the lines, and a grease thumb split cle-
at on the carbon. Old guess 480.00 on CT-5488 is pencilled at the top and is not the labour figure. Stamp says BENCH COPY.

ask.name: jobs
ask.instruction: Each job line on the ticket

marked_text:
Canvas loft note from West Bay. Nadine Ebanks pinned it above the cutting table before lunch. Mangrove Canvas Works bill WB-2294 logs the job at [[started]]22 April 2027 9:15 am[[/]]. Face gross is [[gross]]3,240.80[[/]] and the credit note is [[credit]]415.30[[/]]. A separate promise date is [[promised]]03/02/2027[[/]]. She wrote "see you soon" along the hem, and the scan broke can-
vas through the logo. A crossed-out guess of 2,900.00 sits in the corner and is not the balance. Stamp says LOFT COPY, initials NE, with a smear of chalk on the total box.

ask.name: promised
ask.instruction: The other date written on the sheet

marked_text:
Yard docket copied in Plymouth, Montserrat. Cedric Buffonge wrote it after the afternoon shower, the sheet still cockled. Gage Timber Yard bill MS-8840 names [[item]]cedar sill board[[/]], [[item]]galvanised hinge pair[[/]], and [[item]]roofing felt roll[[/]]. The three charges read [[charge]]128.40[[/]], [[charge]]76.15[[/]], and [[charge]]349.20[[/]]. Docket date [[issued]]28/11/2026[[/]]. He put "tek care" in the corner, and the copier split galva-
nised on the fold. Last year tally 610.40 on MS-8702 is stapled behind this and is a different bill. A blurred PAID stamp covers the telephone line.

ask.instruction: Each material line on the docket
